questions.stem: Two parents who are both heterozygous for a trait (Tt) have a child. What is the probability that the child will be homozygous recessive (tt)?
questions.explanation: Using a Punnett square for Tt x Tt, the possible offspring genotypes are TT, Tt, Tt, and tt. There is a 1 in 4 (25%) chance of the child being homozygous recessive (tt).
